name: Dorobune to Tsumibito
source:
In the sealed ghost town, the former imperial capital "Kuroganejima," a gruesome serial murder case once took place.

Kotoha, seeking the truth behind her parents' deaths, teams up with detective Takara to unravel the mystery of the incident.

It was meant to be a modest act of resistance to settle their pasts. That was all it was supposed to be...

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4148080/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
在被封印的鬼城、前帝都“黑金岛”，曾经发生过一起令人毛骨悚然的连环杀人案。

琴叶寻找父母死亡的真相，与侦探宝联手解开事件之谜。

这本来是一种温和的抵抗行为，以解决他们的过去。这就是它应该的一切……

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4148080/]Steam[/url]]
